title: Make a bill and collect a payment
summary: Find what is owed, take the money, and give the receipt.

steps.title: Open Billing
steps.narration: Open Billing from the menu. This is where every bill and payment lives.

steps.title: Who owes money
steps.narration: On the left, To collect lists the patients who still owe money, with the amount. On the right are all the bills. Tap a status to filter them.

steps.title: Open a bill
steps.narration: Tap a bill to see what it is made of. You will see each line, what was paid, and what is left.

steps.title: Read the bill
steps.narration: The balance is at the bottom of the totals. You can print the bill, or send it by WhatsApp or email.

steps.title: Collect
steps.narration: To take a payment, tap Collect.

steps.title: Amount
steps.narration: The amount starts as the full balance. If the patient pays part now, type the smaller amount.

steps.title: How they paid
steps.narration: Choose how they paid: cash, UPI or card.

steps.title: Record it
steps.narration: Tap Record. The payment is saved and a receipt is made.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.narration: The bill now shows as paid, with the receipt number. You can print the receipt or send it to the patient.

steps.title: A new bill
steps.narration: To make a bill from scratch, tap New bill, choose the patient, add the services, and issue it.
